Every 5 minutes the model receives all the channels below as a stack of 64 × 64 maps ( numbers per step, against 6 numbers for each of ~150 zones in world model v1), plus the static layers and the context. Counts are over the last 5 minutes for flows, or at the moment for the fleet. The two dispatch channels are the platform's actions: where it told drivers to move from and to.

Everything the model sees at this moment (click to enlarge)

Hidden from the model truth, never an input

true congestion: travel time ÷ free-flow time on the cell's roads (white = free flow, dark = 2.5× or more)
what the model gets instead: GPS speed of moving cabs (km/h), only where cabs happen to drive

A world model that learned real world features should be able to recover the left map from the right one and from how its cabs' trips slow down. Step 4 tests this with a probe, along with the hidden rain effect, zone types and each driver's acceptance tendency.
